description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Grazing Kelpie
When Grazing Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Grazing Kelpie enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grazing Kelpie
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
